description: This source file defines a gateway communication layer for a client application, including protocols, actors, and classes to manage WebSocket connections, authentication, and message handling with a remote gateway server. It includes connection management, reconnection logic, request/response handling, and security token management.

classes.name: WebSocketTasking
classes.description: Protocol defining WebSocket task operations such as resume, cancel, send, and receive.

classes.name: WebSocketTaskBox
classes.description: A boxed, thread-safe wrapper around an object conforming to WebSocketTasking, providing methods to control WebSocket tasks.

classes.name: WebSocketSessionBox
classes.description: A simple container for an object conforming to WebSocketSessioning.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: Configuration data for establishing a gateway connection, including roles, scopes, permissions, identifiers, and modes.

classes.name: GatewayAuthSource
classes.description: Enum representing different authentication source types such as device token, shared token, bootstrap token, password, or none.

classes.name: GatewayChannelActor
classes.description: Actor managing the lifecycle of a WebSocket connection to a gateway, including connecting, reconnecting, messaging, and auth handling.

methods.name: connect()
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the gateway, with reconnection logic and response handling.

methods.name: shutdown()
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the connection, canceling tasks and notifying waiters.

methods.name: sendPing()
methods.description: Sends a WebSocket ping to keep the connection alive.

methods.name: request()
methods.description: Sends a request to the gateway and awaits a response, handling timeouts and errors.

methods.name: send()
methods.description: Sends a message to the gateway.

methods.name: wrap()
methods.description: Wraps low-level errors with context information for better diagnostics.

methods.name: connectOrThrow()
methods.description: Ensures a connection is established, attempting to connect if not already connected.

methods.name: encodeRequest()
methods.description: Encodes a gateway request into data for transmission over WebSocket.

methods.name: failPending()
methods.description: Fails all pending requests with a provided error.

methods.name: timeoutRequest()
methods.description: Handles timeout for a specific request by its identifier.
